articles.title: Milk Mafia Busted! Viral Video Exposes Crate Heist Gang in West Delhi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a swift crackdown, the Anti-Narcotics Squad of Outer District Police has busted a gang involved in stealing milk and curd crates in the Uttam Nagar area, arresting two accused who were caught on camera.

body.html:
In a swift crackdown, the Anti-Narcotics Squad of Outer District Police has busted a gang involved in stealing milk and curd crates in the Uttam Nagar area, arresting two accused who were caught on camera.

The action followed a viral YouTube video dated March 26, 2026, which exposed the duo allegedly stealing dairy supplies from delivery points. Taking cognisance, a special team was constituted under the supervision of ACP (Operations) Virender Singh to trace the suspects.

After scanning over 300 CCTV footages and activating local intelligence, police identified the accused. Acting on a tip-off, a trap was laid near a church in Shiv Vihar, Vikas Nagar on April 3, where the two suspects — Mohit alias Patha (27) and Ayush Maan Pandey alias Pandit (19), both residents of Ranhola — were arrested.

Police recovered a stolen Bajaj Maximo three-wheeler and 14 empty milk crates from their possession. Verification revealed that the vehicle had been stolen from Prem Nagar in Rohini. During interrogation, the accused confessed to stealing milk and curd from Uttam Nagar and selling them in Dabri and Bindapur.

Further investigation led to the recovery of a stolen Honda Activa and a Honda motorcycle, linked to separate cases registered at Tilak Nagar and Ranhola police stations.

Police said the accused used to follow milk supply vehicles and target crates left unattended during deliveries. The stolen goods were transported using stolen vehicles and sold to local vendors.

Officials revealed that Mohit is a habitual offender with involvement in 38 cases of theft, snatching and motor vehicle theft, while Ayush is relatively new to criminal activities.

With their arrest, police have worked out five cases, including multiple vehicle thefts and dairy product thefts registered across different police stations. All stolen items have been seized, and further investigation is underway.

#DelhiPolice #CrimeNews #UttamNagar #TheftGang #ViralVideo

articles.title: “Dragged for 1 KM!” Woman Killed, Husband Critical After DCM Hits Scooty in Hyderabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a horrific road accident in Hyderabad’s Madhapur area, a 22-year-old woman was killed while her husband sustained grievous injuries after a DCM vehicle hit their scooty and dragged it for nearly a kilometre.

body.html:
In a horrific road accident in Hyderabad’s Madhapur area, a 22-year-old woman was killed while her husband sustained grievous injuries after a DCM vehicle hit their scooty and dragged it for nearly a kilometre.

The deceased, Haniya Ayesha, was riding with her husband Abdul Basit (26) when the incident occurred late Saturday night (4 April 2026) near Mindspace in the IT hub.

According to police, the vehicle rammed into their scooty, causing Basit to fall aside, while Ayesha, along with the vehicle, was dragged for about a kilometre. Passersby chased the DCM and managed to stop it, but the driver fled the scene. The cleaner was caught by locals, thrashed, and later handed over to the police.

Both victims were rushed to AIG Hospital, where doctors declared Ayesha brought dead. Basit is currently undergoing treatment for serious injuries.

The couple, originally from Kerala, worked at a Malabar Gold store and were returning home to Maheshwaram after watching a movie in Kukatpally.

Madhapur Police have registered a case and launched a manhunt for the absconding driver. The vehicle involved is reportedly registered in Karnataka.

articles.title: “QR Code Exposes Murder Plot!” Wife, Lover Arrested Within 24 Hours in Agra Killing
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a sensational case near Agra, police solved a murder within 24 hours using a QR code clue, leading to the arrest of the victim’s wife, her lover, and an accomplice. The victim, Lokendra, had gone missing on April 1. His partially burnt body was later found by the roadside.

body.html:
In a sensational case near Agra, police solved a murder within 24 hours using a QR code clue, leading to the arrest of the victim’s wife, her lover, and an accomplice.

The victim, Lokendra, had gone missing on April 1. His partially burnt body was later found by the roadside. Identification was confirmed through a tattoo on his body.

Acting on a complaint filed by Lokendra’s brother, police suspected a conspiracy involving his wife and her alleged partner, Mahesh. Multiple teams were formed to investigate the case.

A breakthrough came when police recovered an empty liquor bottle from the crime scene. Using the QR code on the bottle, investigators traced the liquor shop and scanned its CCTV footage. The footage showed Lokendra visiting the shop along with Mahesh and another man, Dharamveer.

Based on this evidence, police detained the suspects. During interrogation, Mahesh allegedly confessed that Lokendra had discovered his extramarital relationship with his wife and had strongly opposed it.

According to police, the accused lured Lokendra to an isolated field on the pretext of drinking. After consuming alcohol together, Mahesh and Dharamveer allegedly strangled him and later set his body on fire to destroy evidence. The wife is accused of conspiring in the murder.

All three accused have been arrested, and further investigation is underway.

#Agra #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #UPPolice

articles.title: “Instagram Love Turns Deadly!” Woman Killed in Sugarcane Field After ₹1.5 Lakh ‘Romance Scam’
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda district, where a woman was allegedly killed by her lover following a prolonged dispute over money and deception.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda district, where a woman was allegedly killed by her lover following a prolonged dispute over money and deception.

The deceased, Sheela (around 22–25), had reportedly met Arun Kumar, a mechanic from Bihar, through Instagram nearly four years ago. She allegedly introduced herself as the daughter of a wealthy family, and the two soon entered into a relationship, frequently meeting at hotels.

According to police sources, Sheela began demanding money from Arun over time. Starting with ₹20,000 in 2022, she allegedly continued to seek funds in multiple instalments, eventually taking around ₹1.5 lakh through cash and online transfers. Arun, who worked as an electrician and mechanic, reportedly spent his hard-earned savings on her.

Investigators say Arun grew suspicious of being deceived, especially after repeated arguments and Sheela’s reluctance to introduce him to her family.

On the day of the incident, Arun allegedly took Sheela to a sugarcane field on the pretext of making a reel, tied her hands, and slit her throat with a knife. Her body was later found in the field, triggering panic in the village.

Police said Sheela had been missing since March 29, after which her family lodged a complaint. Her body was recovered five days later from the same area.

Superintendent of Police Vineet Jaiswal confirmed that multiple teams, including SOG and surveillance units, have been deployed to investigate the case. Police are examining call records and other evidence to establish the full sequence of events.

The incident has sparked outrage locally, highlighting the dangers of online relationships turning into exploitation and violence.

#Gonda #UPCrime #MurderCase #BreakingNews #Instagram

articles.title: “Bus Chased & Attacked!” Drunk Youths Pelt Stones After Overtaking Row, Paraded by Police
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident, police arrested four accused for vandalising a roadways bus and assaulting its driver following a dispute over overtaking in the Gadarpur area. The incident took place on Wednesday when a bus from Tanakpur depot was on its way to Haridwar.

body.html:
In a shocking incident, police arrested four accused for vandalising a roadways bus and assaulting its driver following a dispute over overtaking in the Gadarpur area.

The incident took place on Wednesday when a bus from Tanakpur depot was on its way to Haridwar. Near Gadarpur, an argument broke out between the bus driver and a bike riderwhile overtaking. Though the matter initially subsided after public intervention, the biker later called his associates and chased the bus.

The accused attempted to stop the bus near Kelakheda, and when the driver did not halt, they allegedly began pelting stones at the moving vehicle, creating panic among passengers. The driver later stopped the bus at Doraha Chowki and informed the police.

Based on the complaint by driver Sharda Shankar, police registered an FIR against unknown persons and launched an investigation.

Police arrested the main accused, Harjinder Singh, followed by the arrest of Rinku Singh, Govind Singh, and Ayan. During interrogation, the accused admitted they were intoxicated and attacked the bus after the dispute.

Two motorcycles, reportedly used in the incident and without number plates, have also been seized.

In a strong message, police paraded the accused on foot along the highway, where they were seen pleading. Officials stated that such acts of hooliganism and damage to public property will not be tolerated.

The accused have been produced in court, and efforts are ongoing to trace other involved individuals.

#Uttarakhand #BreakingNews #RoadRage #BusAttack #PoliceAction

articles.title: “Drunk Drama at Toll Plaza!” Woman Uproots Barricades Over ‘Missing Phone’ in Jhansi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young woman allegedly created chaos at Luhari Toll Plaza on the Jhansi–Khajuraho highway after claiming her mobile phone was stolen, leading to vandalism and a heated confrontation with staff. The incident occurred on Friday under the Sakrar police station limits.

body.html:
A young woman allegedly created chaos at Luhari Toll Plaza on the Jhansi–Khajuraho highway after claiming her mobile phone was stolen, leading to vandalism and a heated confrontation with staff.

The incident occurred on Friday under the Sakrar police station limits. According to toll manager Saurav Panwar, a car carrying three to four women and two men had arrived from Mauranipur after attending a programme in Naugaon. Soon after stopping at the toll, one of the women stepped out, accused the staff of theft, and began creating a ruckus.

Eyewitnesses said the woman, reportedly intoxicated, uprooted multiple barricades and threw them aside while abusing toll workers. She repeatedly demanded to be shown CCTV footage, alleging her phone had been stolen at the plaza.

Despite attempts by staff to calm her and direct her to the CCTV room, the situation escalated, forcing toll employees to call Dial 100 and inform the police.

When police arrived, the woman’s companions also reached the spot. They later admitted that the phone had not been stolen at the toll plaza, following which the group left the scene.

Sakrar police confirmed that no formal complaint has been filed so far, stating that the matter was resolved on the spot. Authorities said further action will be taken if a complaint is received.

The video of the incident has since gone viral, raising concerns over public behaviour and safety at toll plazas.

#Jhansi #ViralVideo #BreakingNews #UPNews #PublicNuisance #TollPlaza #IndiaNews #Police #LawAndOrder

articles.title: “Fake GST Raid Busted!” Traders Catch Extortion Gang Posing as Officials in Ghazipur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major expose in Shadiabad town of Uttar Pradesh’s Ghazipur district, local traders caught a gang posing as Income Tax and GST officials who were allegedly extorting money from shopkeepers.

body.html:
In a major expose in Shadiabad town of Uttar Pradesh’s Ghazipur district, local traders caught a gang posing as Income Tax and GST officials who were allegedly extorting money from shopkeepers.

The incident took place on Thursday evening when the gang arrived in a four-wheeler and began targeting local businesses, claiming to be officials from Lucknow. They first approached Sitaram Grocery Store and allegedly demanded ₹50,000, later settling for ₹10,000 after repeated pleading. They then extorted ₹3,000 from another shop and demanded ₹30,000 at a third store.

Suspicion arose when the accused gave inconsistent answers during questioning at Srinivas Grocery Store. As tensions grew, local traders gathered and confronted them. Amid the chaos, the gang leader, identified as Saras Gupta, managed to escape from the spot.

Police were alerted and reached the scene, detaining seven individuals, including a woman. The accused have been identified as Anil Kumar (Varanasi), Sadanand Prasad (Sadat), Pramod Kumar (Yusufpur), Ravi Patel (Varanasi), Deva Patel (Varanasi), Sanket Gupta (Muhammadabad), and Sushila Gupta (Yusufpur). Their vehicle, an Innova Crysta, has also been seized.

Police said the gang used fake identity cards and threats of legal action, including heavy fines and jail, to intimidate traders into paying money. Preliminary investigation suggests the accused had been involved in similar activities earlier as well.

Based on a complaint by the shopkeeper, a case has been registered and efforts are underway to arrest the absconding kingpin, Saras Gupta.

The incident triggered anger among traders, with a large crowd gathering at the spot as the accused were handed over to police.

#Ghazipur #UPNews #FakeGST #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: “Murder, Then Instagram Boast!” Delhi Teen Stabs Man Dead, Posts Video After Crime
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking case from Delhi, a 20-year-old man was stabbed to death in the Shalimar Bagh area, with the main accused later posting a video on Instagram boasting about the murder.

body.html:
In a shocking case from Delhi, a 20-year-old man was stabbed to death in the Shalimar Bagh area, with the main accused later posting a video on Instagram boasting about the murder.

The victim, Nitesh alias Nikki, was attacked late Thursday night near Haiderpur Canal following a minor dispute. According to police, the main accused, Karan alias Tarun (18), along with his associates Monty (22) and a juvenile, allegedly stabbed him multiple times.

The injured victim was rushed to Dr. Ambedkar Hospital, where doctors declared him brought dead.

In a disturbing twist, the accused Karan later uploaded a video on Instagram, claiming responsibility for the murder and telling his followers he would be “going to jail for a few days,” sparking outrage on social media.

Acting swiftly, Delhi Police used technical surveillance and local inputs to solve the case within four hours. All three accused were apprehended, with the juvenile detained and the other two arrested. Police said the accused have confessed to their involvement.

Further investigation is underway to establish the complete sequence of events and recover the weapon used in the crime.

#Delhi #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #ShalimarBagh

articles.title: “Sweeping Road, Then Hit by Speeding Car!” Police Constable’s Vehicle Runs Over Woman in Bidar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a tragic incident in Bhalki town of Karnataka’s Bidar district, a 45-year-old woman was critically injured after being run over by a car allegedly driven by a police constable.

body.html:
In a tragic incident in Bhalki town of Karnataka’s Bidar district, a 45-year-old woman was critically injured after being run over by a car allegedly driven by a police constable.

The victim, Gyanabai, a resident of Bhalki, was sweeping the road on Friday morning when the accident occurred. According to reports, a speeding car driven by constable Umakant, attached to Mehakar Police Station, hit her.

Gyanabai sustained serious injuries, particularly to her leg, and was rushed to a private hospital in Bidar, where she remains in critical condition.

The incident, which occurred within Bhalki Nagar police station limits, was captured on CCTV cameras. The footage, reportedly showing a young boy crying at the scene, has intensified the emotional impact of the Incident.

Police have registered a case and initiated an investigation into the matter.

#Bidar #Karnataka #BreakingNews #Police #ViralVideo

articles.title: “Shot 5 Times, Still Drove 25 KM!” Bail Out Accused Battles for Life After Ghaziabad Shooting
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 35-year-old man, identified as Rahul Chaudhary, was shot multiple times by armed assailants outside a roadside eatery in Modinagar, Ghaziabad, on Thursday night. The incident occurred around 9:30 pm near a dhaba along NH-58 in the Seekri Kalan area.

body.html:
A 35-year-old man, identified as Rahul Chaudhary, was shot multiple times by armed assailants outside a roadside eatery in Modinagar, Ghaziabad, on Thursday night.

The incident occurred around 9:30 pm near a dhaba along NH-58 in the Seekri Kalan area. CCTV footage shows two men waiting near a scooter as Chaudhary arrived in his Scorpio. One of them opened the driver-side door, following which a third accuse approached and fired multiple shots at close range before calmly walking away. The attackers then fled on the scooter.

Despite sustaining five bullet injuries to his neck, chest, abdomen and leg, Chaudhary managed to drive over 25 km for more than 30 minutes to Yashoda Hospital. He reportedly entered the hospital on his own, called for help, and collapsed shortly after. He underwent emergency surgery and is currently in critical condition.

Police said Chaudhary had gone to meet acquaintances to collect ₹75,000 when the attack took place. His wife alleged that the meeting was arranged by known individuals and has claimed a larger conspiracy involving multiple accused.

According to police records, Chaudhary has a criminal history with 18 cases, including murder, attempt to murder and extortion. He was out on bail in an extortion case at the time of the attack.

Based on the complaint, police have registered a case under relevant sections for attempt to murder and criminal conspiracy. Five teams have been formed to trace the accused, and CCTV footage from nearby areas is being analysed.

#Ghaziabad #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #UPPolice #Shooting
